designThesis: The page is a locked chase on the platen, not a portfolio gallery: one real edition sheet in a thin harbour-ink chase frame (default Harbour Night), edition name set as locked metal type, ticket rail for true press facts, primary action Enquire about this edition; coral registration cross is the sole accent and UI selection/focus grammar.
subjectGrounding: Atelier Møn Printworks — coastal letterpress (posters, map editions, shop bags for island shops). Audience: curators and small brands commissioning limited runs. Journey: view edition → paper/edition facts → enquire. Vernacular: Heidelberg platen, press sheets, gripper edges, registration crosses, chalk white, harbour ink. Editions: Harbour Night, Chalk Path, Ferry Board. Forbidden: invented awards, false museum placements. Anti-references: agency blob gradients, stock loft photos. Dials: density 4, motion 3, boldness 7.
composition: Desktop locked-chase: press sheet left/center inside thin ink chase frame, job-ticket rail right; three edition plates in one calm grip-edge row below; enquire form as order-slip band. Narrow: sheet then ticket stack. Open chalk space (density 4), not broadsheet packing.
informationHierarchy: 1) Active edition image+name 2) Press facts in ticket mono (stock, edition size, Heidelberg platen when present) 3) Enquire CTA 4) Other editions as selection set 5) Short studio note. No decorative 01/02/03 markers.
typography: Display: condensed jobbing grotesque (e.g. Barlow Condensed 600–700, tight tracking) for edition titles. Body: quiet book serif (e.g. Source Serif 4 400/600), 45–75ch. Ticket: tabular mono (e.g. IBM Plex Mono) for stock, edition size, press type labels. Avoid Inter/Space Grotesk/Roboto as identity.
colourAndMaterialModel: Chalk White #F4F2EC ground; Harbour Ink #15202B type/chase rules; Ink Wash #5C6670 secondary; Sheet Edge #D9D4C8 borders/shallow paper shadow; Registration Coral #E85A4F sole accent. Flat paper, no blob gradients, no secondary brand hue.
imageryAndAssetStrategy: Load-bearing: three edition-on-sheet photographs (harbour-night.webp have, chalk-path.webp have, ferry-board.webp needed). Missing Ferry Board = honest chalk pending plate with ticket label, no loft stock fill. Optional registration diagram only if clarifying the mark system. Crop for paper/ink reality, not lifestyle.
interactionConcept: Motion intensity 3: one sheet-settle-into-forme on load (~300ms); edition hover 2px lift; coral for focus/active only, no ambient loop. Reduced-motion: static. Form: Send enquiry / Enquiry sent.
signatureElement: Coral registration cross as sole accent system — sheet overlay, focus ring language, active-edition glyph on grip-edge strip.
primaryRisk: Registration-as-UI collapses into generic red accent if the mark is not drawn as a precise print registration cross or if a second accent creeps in.
implementationGuidance: Tokenize five colours only; three type roles with metric fallbacks; edition state swaps sheet+ticket facts; bind ticket rows only to real evidence (omit empty); replace Ferry Board pending plate when asset exists; thin ink chase rule not heavy sticker border; no hero gradients; no awards/museum/testimonials; quality floor mobile stack/focus/reduced-motion.
unknowns: Specific paper stock names and edition sizes not supplied in pack — leave as content slots, do not invent. Ferry Board photograph pending. Dark mode not specified.
